text.hi: in, un, dis, non = नहीं; over = बहुत ज़्यादा; re = फिर से; fore = पहले। जैसे: redo (फिर करना), overeat (ज़्यादा खाना)।
text.hinglish: in, un, dis, non = nahi; over = bahut zyaada; re = phir se; fore = pehle. Jaise: redo (phir karna), overeat (zyaada khaana).
text.en: in, un, dis, non = not; over = too much; re = again; fore = before. Example: redo, overeat.

steps.sentence: Many drivers ___ the speed restriction on roads. (obey)

meaning.hi: बहुत से ड्राइवर सड़क पर गति सीमा नहीं मानते।
meaning.hinglish: Bahut se driver sadak par gati seema nahi maante.

steps.sentence: I had to ___ the directions because I couldn't understand them. (read)

meaning.hi: मुझे निर्देश फिर से पढ़ने पड़े क्योंकि समझ नहीं आए।
meaning.hinglish: Mujhe nirdesh phir se padhne pade kyonki samajh nahi aaye.

steps.sentence: The garden hasn't been mown, so weeds have ___. (grown)

meaning.hi: बग़ीचे की घास नहीं कटी, इसलिए खरपतवार बहुत बढ़ गई है।
meaning.hinglish: Bageeche ki ghaas nahi kati, isliye kharpatwaar bahut badh gayi hai.

steps.sentence: I ___ the ball she had lost. (placed)

meaning.hi: उसकी खोई गेंद की जगह मैंने नई गेंद दे दी।
meaning.hinglish: Uski khoyi gend ki jagah maine nayi gend de di.

steps.sentence: These slippers are made of ___ plastic. (cycled)

meaning.hi: ये चप्पलें दोबारा इस्तेमाल हुए प्लास्टिक से बनी हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Yeh chappalein dobaara istemaal hue plastic se bani hain.

text.hi: (b) fore = पहले: forecast (पहले से अनुमान), foretell (भविष्य बताना), forenoon (दोपहर से पहले), forefront (सबसे आगे), forefathers (पूर्वज)।
text.hinglish: (b) fore = pehle: forecast (pehle se anumaan), foretell (bhavishya bataana), forenoon (dopahar se pehle), forefront (sabse aage), forefathers (poorvaj).
text.en: (b) fore = before: forecast, foretell, forenoon, forefront, forefathers.
